more_info.overview: Dicalcium diphosphate is calcium pyrophosphate, a calcium salt containing the diphosphate group. That group joins two phosphorus-containing units and differs from orthophosphate. Calcium pyrophosphate can occur in different hydrated or crystalline forms. The historical dataset entry does not identify a single form or a specific current commercial food application. An assessment of a different calcium phosphate cannot define this preparation.
